# Delivery requirement register

**Current enforcing-phase override:** The owner's [4 October playable-first decision](../delivery-workflow.md#playable-first) applies to every inherited source/profile/dependency/review/publication criterion below. Pre-P0-035 playable development slices do not wait for matched performance baselines, deep profiling, exhaustive fault/device/retention/cadence campaigns or global CHECK-* qualification. Those unchanged obligations retain their named P0-032/034/035 and source owners; local gameplay, schema/admission, build and ordinary lifecycle remain required. Existing row IDs, criteria and historical statuses are retained; scoped playable acceptance/publication is not full element or engine closure.

**Enforcing CAT acceptance:** Every CAT-001–CAT-072 D/I/V row additionally includes its [explicit current-element requirement](requirements.md#current-catalogue-closure) and [capability/collaborator order](invest/vertical-delivery.md#existing-element-order). D freezes that behavior's canonical configuration, finite model and actual required collaborators; I admits only that decided vertical with its worker/animation/render criteria; V closes every remaining mode and fixture with independent current proof. All existing elements remain Incomplete until their own gates pass, and collectively block P0-035. Reference-row order is navigation, never an alphabetical execution prerequisite. Earlier inventory/design Passes do not complete parts or waive this reconciliation.

**Current architecture:** [Canonical Half game values and WGSL f16 physics](../gpu-f16-physics.md) define the numerical model. Current design/acceptance is self-contained; implementation and qualification status are in [TODO](../../TODO.md).

**4,558 retained register rows**; **P0-035** remains the mandatory engine gate. Every substantive obligation, row ID, proof and recorded status remains required. VERTICAL-INVEST-PLAN-2026-10-02 revises obsolete technical completion edges and horizontal acceptance; the current rows govern, while frozen originals remain history. Related D/I/CLEAN/F/U/V/closure rows are subordinate criteria within a small functional slice, not mandatory fresh-agent or separate-publication assignments. Reference order and former predecessor are navigation only; technical prerequisites and stage gates remain binding. See [slice workflow](../delivery-workflow.md#paired-subagent-workflow).
